data.name: Glass Drop
data.detailed_description:
Glass Drop is a physics-based falling merge puzzle game. Drop beautiful glass bubbles into the box and collide bubbles of the same color and size to evolve them into even larger ones.

[Goals and Rules] The controls are simple—just choose where to drop! When the same type of bubbles touch, they merge with a satisfying glass sound and evolve into the next tier (Red, Blue, Green... all the way to Rainbow!). If the bubbles overflow from the box, it's game over. Manage your space carefully, predict the physics, and aim for the highest score possible.

[Two Game Modes]

  • Normal Mode: The classic mode where you take your time, plan your drops, and aim for a high score through strategic merges and chains.

  • Explode Mode: An exhilarating mode where bubbles can shatter into beautiful glass fragments. Enjoy the unpredictable physics and the highly satisfying visual of breaking glass!
